season.evidence: Web search: Mountaineers Primus/Borealis route page and trip reports favour early summer when snow bridges the glacier and makes Lucky Pass easy, while late season turns the direct line to ice; ascents histogram peaks Jul (15) then Jun (7). Stored Jul-Sep kept; usable window with margin is Jun-Oct.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 23 2025, summited, but the report and the track's highest point (1 km from our summit pin, at Primus) show a Primus plus Tricouni link-up, and the recording starts at McAllister Camp, not the trailhead.
May 2 ascent, a full-day round trip that also tops Primus (highest point at Primus); out of season and a link-up.
May 2 ascent, partial track starting at Lucky Pass; out of season.
January winter ascent that also climbs Primus.
April 17 ascent, no track points checked.

facts.text: In late August, the Thunder Creek crossing near the old bridge site needed only a little wading, and a log near the log jam just upstream gave a way across on the return; earlier in summer the creek is deeper.
In late August the glacier above Borealis Lake is crevassed and meandering, with a long, tedious traverse to Lucky Pass; allow time for route-finding there.

notes: The only in-season summited tracks are Primus plus Tricouni link-ups, so none is assigned. Our stored text names Lucky Pass as the way to the peak, consistent with all recordings.
